showReadOnlyProtection.name: show read-only protection
showReadOnlyProtection.description: Whether to show the read-only protection option in the developer mode
showReadOnlyProtection.description[zh_CN]: 是否在开发者模式中显示只读保护选项

bootWallpaperEnabled.name: edit boot wallpaper
bootWallpaperEnabled.description: Is the GRUB "boot menu" wallpaper editable?
bootWallpaperEnabled.description[zh_CN]: "启动菜单"grub背景图片可否编辑

bootGrubUserNameVisible.name: boot grub userName visible
bootGrubUserNameVisible.description: Whether to show the username in the verification password pop-up window of "Startup Menu Verification"
bootGrubUserNameVisible.description[zh_CN]: 是否在"启动菜单验证"的验证密码弹窗中显示用户名

bootGrubDelayIntervalMax.name: bootGrubDelayIntervalMax
bootGrubDelayIntervalMax.description: GRUB timeout in seconds when boot delay is enabled. Default: 5. Integers are clamped to [5, 10]; fractional, non-finite or non-numeric values use the default.
bootGrubDelayIntervalMax.description[zh_CN]: 开启延时启动时使用的 GRUB 超时秒数，默认为 5。整数限制在 [5, 10]，越界取最近边界；小数、非有限数或无法转换为数值时使用默认值。

bootGrubDelayIntervalMin.name: bootGrubDelayIntervalMin
bootGrubDelayIntervalMin.description: GRUB timeout in seconds when boot delay is disabled. Default: 1. Integers are clamped to [0, 4]; fractional, non-finite or non-numeric values use the default.
bootGrubDelayIntervalMin.description[zh_CN]: 关闭延时启动时使用的 GRUB 超时秒数，默认为 1。整数限制在 [0, 4]，越界取最近边界；小数、非有限数或无法转换为数值时使用默认值。
